summaries.body:
ASVS 5.0.0 V11.2.1 is carried forward from 4.0.3 V6.2.2, which required industry-proven or government-approved cryptographic algorithms, modes, and libraries instead of custom-coded cryptography, with an OWASP Proactive Control C8 pointer. The official mapping records it as MODIFIED and moved from v4.0.3-6.2.2 into Cryptography’s implementation section.

On 2019-02-24 tghosth added the C8 “proactive verify” wording to V6.2.2. Later git events on the 5.0 ID (business-logic split #1211, files, SSRF, cookies) are slot reuse after V11 ceased to be Business Logic. Mapping and the V6.2.2 predecessor are the reliable origin.

V6.2.2 covered algorithms, modes, and libraries in one clause. In 5.0 this ID keeps the implementation/library demand and names hardware-accelerated implementations; approved algorithms and modes were split into V11.3. The prohibition on custom-coded cryptography is no longer in this sentence. The mapping calls that MODIFIED.

tghosth’s 2019-02-24 C8 link is the attested 4.0 wording event on the predecessor. elar’s 2022-04-19 commit that now sits on V11.2.1 split anti-automation from business logic (#1211) and did not rewrite this cryptography clause.
